name: Gabriel Nagel
description: Gabriel's journey with ASES began in bootcamp and continued as Director of Engagement, where he led 20+ VC dinners, raised $10K, and brought speakers from YC to OpenAI to over 600 students. Outside of ASES, he is passionate about climate, serving as Chair of the U.S. EPA's first youth-led advisory council and gaining experience at Congress, the World Bank, and JPMorgan. Majoring in Economics and Philosophy, Gabriel is originally from Colorado and enjoys hiking 14ers and practicing meditation.

name: Katie Cheng
description: Katie is a junior studying Computer Science on the AI track with a minor in Art Practice. She was born and raised in the East Bay Area and some of her life's joys include portraiture painting, traveling for hackathons, thrifting in big cities, and betting too much in poker. She's explored software, product, and growth roles at early to late stage startups like Terra API (YC W21), Scale AI, and Anthropic, but is specifically into computer vision, wearables, and game development.

name: Laolu Oguneye
description: My name is Laolu Oguneye and I'll be serving as one of the Bootcamp co-directors this year. I'm a sophomore from Atlanta, GA studying computer science (AI) with a minor in math. In the past I've built a venture in climate-tech and I spent the past summer doing machine learning work at Google under their Shopping team. On campus, I'm involved with the track team, club basketball, and the SBSE, and I'm super interested in all things sports, poetry, good food, and finding new places to travel.

name: Michael Yu
description: Hi I'm Michael! I'm planning on study Engineering Physics at Stanford. I'm interested in how startups can be leveraged to make larger positive societal impacts. I also like taking photos, swimming, DJing, and wandering in the outdoors!

name: Amari Luu
description: Amari is a sophomore studying the humanities. He is into history and writing, having published a WWII book and having two children's books (and accompanying stuffed animals) scheduled for release later this year. He also builds scale models and designs card games.

name: Khoi Lam
description: Khoi is a sophomore from Houston, TX majoring in CS and AI. He is CTO at Admitium, an education platform with 600K+ followers, and runs a software-development agency in partnership with the Web Prodigies YouTube channel. He is also co-founding Omitask, a personal productivity assistant startup. He enjoys playing guitar, badminton, ping pong, and a bit of poker. Feel free to reach out to Khoi at kholam@stanford.edu!

name: Emma Shultz
description: Hi! I'm a sophomore at Stanford planning to double major in economics and math. I work as an analyst at a venture capital firm in New York, where I get to research startups, learn about new industries, and support early-stage founders. Fun fact: I have a twin sister who goes to UC Berkeley (the rivalry is real).

name: Hannah Gao
description: Hannah is a sophomore at Stanford studying math, computer science, and visual arts, interested in making technology more human. In her free time, you can find her buried in her laptop at a coffee shop, playing guitar, or taking laps around lake lag.

name: Bryann-Noel Rivella
description: Hi! I'm Bryann-Noel Revilla, a sophomore planning to study Electrical Engineering. I love reading, listening to music, and fueling up on tea or caffeine. I'm super excited to be co-directing Engagement this year and can't wait to help build an even more connected ASES community!

name: Danica Sun
description: Danica is a sophomore at Stanford studying Computer Science and Energy Science & Engineering. She has spoken at the United Nations Climate Summit (COP28) and has been featured by outlets including Fox, NBC5, the Chicago Tribune, the NYT, and NPR Chicago. She is passionate about leveraging technology to build solutions that win because they are faster, more innovative, and more efficient—and also tackle global challenges like climate change. This past summer, she was the first hire and engineer at an energy and industrial development startup. She now works with a climate tech VC firm, develops energy optimization and load-balancing algorithms for Stanford Research Computing, and leads Stanford Climate Week. Outside of work, you can find her biking and frolicking throughout the Bay, enjoying a good matcha with friends, then reviewing that matcha + her latest eats on Beli (@danicasun).

name: Komal Vij
description: Komal Vij is a junior from the Bay Area pursuing a major in Computer Science on the AI track. Her interests lie at the intersection of AI for safety applications, and she has a deep love for entrepreneurship. In her free time, Komal enjoys spending time in nature or experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen.

name: Yameen Sekandari
description: Yameen is a sophomore from Phoenix, studying CS with a minor in Music. He is deeply interested in the intersection of natural language processing and education. In his free time, Yameen likes to make beats, play basketball, and going on hikes.

name: Edward Han
description: Edward is a sophomore from Illinois majoring in Computer Science with a minor in International Relations. He is interested in emerging technologies, like drones, AI, and cyber capabilities, and their national security implications. In his free time, he fences on the Stanford fencing team, plays pool, and hikes with friends.

name: Zeyneb Kaya
description: Hi, I'm Zeyneb a founder and researcher in cs+math. I met some of my closest lifelong friends (and my cofounder) and got introduced to the world of startups through ASES—now I want to help connect cool people and help them found!

name: Andrew Lee
description: Andrew is a sophomore from Taipei, Taiwan majoring in CS and Bioengineering. He is currently building a personal health OS and working on a fintech startup. Andrew's favorite things include fashion, traveling, tennis, basketball, and trying new foods.

name: Kyle Roh
description: Kyle is studying computational biology and electrical engineering, while venture building at the frontiers of machine learning and drug discovery. After creating award‑winning AI drug screening methods against Alzheimer's Disease, Kyle is finding ways to democratize access to novel therapies.

name: Javea Estavillo
description: Javea Estavillo is a Stanford sophomore in Management Science & Engineering and Data Science, passionate about the intersection between climate innovation, finance, and AI. She is a Founders Associate at a Stanford geospatial AI startup, a former GCash intern in finance and AI operations, and a Youth Delegate of the Philippines to COP28.

name: Abigail Fu
description: Abigail is a sophomore studying Symbolic Systems and Economics. She loves anything related to art and psychology, and especially enjoys employing creative solutions to social problems. In her free time, you'll find her climbing, drawing, or exploring new food spots!

name: Vanessa Lim
description: Vanessa is a sophomore studying Economics and MS&E. She is fascinated by how finance can drive innovation and create opportunities in emerging industries, from venture capital to startup growth. She hopes to pursue a career in finance or the startup space. She is currently working at a YC-backed medical AI startup developing AI avatars to train counselors. Outside of academics and work, she enjoys cooking, archery, fashion, and traveling.

name: Samuel Chen
description: Samuel is a sophomore studying materials science and some physics/cs. He's interested in deep tech energy and materials solutions and worked on fusion, energy conversion, and AI for materials discovery. From Las Vegas originally, he enjoys rock climbing, exploring nature, and spending time with friends.

name: Ansh Sheth
description: Ansh is a sophomore from the Bay Area studying computer science. He's passionate about entrepreneurship and using technology to transform the world. In his free time, he loves reading philosophy, playing chess, and listening to music.

name: Rebecca Wang
description: Rebecca is currently on leave, building solutions for enterprise AI adoption. Previously, she founded a gunshot detection startup and hosted the Alexandr Wang look-alike competition.

name: Simmi Sen
description: Simmi is studying Computer Science and Design at Stanford University. She is currently on leave to build Crebit, a stablecoin-powered foreign exchange platform that helps international students and families move money seamlessly.
